name: Hubitat, Sensor
description: One or more Hubitat device attributes as bold value blocks. A single attribute fills the cell as a hero number with a trend arrow + 24h sparkline beneath; several lay out as a list with per-row trend + hairline sparkline. Lead glyph picks up the attribute (temperature → thermometer, humidity → drop, contact → door, motion → walker, switch → toggle, etc.). Requires the Hubitat Core plugin.

cell_options.name: entities
cell_options.label: Device attributes
cell_options.help: Each entry is one attribute of one device (Lounge · Temperature, Front Door · Contact). The list comes from the devices you exposed in the Maker API app on the hub.

cell_options.name: show_trend
cell_options.label: Trend arrow
cell_options.help: Up, down or flat against 24 hours ago.

cell_options.name: show_sparkline
cell_options.label: Sparkline
cell_options.help: The last 24 hours, built from the hub's recent event log for the device. The hub keeps a fixed number of events per device, so a very chatty sensor may cover less than 24 hours.

cell_options.name: show_title
cell_options.label: Title line
cell_options.help: Off hides the whole title row (icon and name), so a single attribute shows just its value.

cell_options.name: title
cell_options.label: Title
cell_options.help: Blank uses the device name, or Sensors when several attributes are listed.

cell_options.name: overrides
cell_options.label: Names, icons and formats
cell_options.help: One row per ticked attribute. Leave the name blank to keep the auto label; pick "No icon" to keep the auto icon. The format box overrides the widget number format for that attribute (blank = use the widget default).

cell_options.name: number_format
cell_options.label: Number format
cell_options.help: How numeric values are shown. Blank rounds to 2 decimals and trims trailing zeros (72.00 → 72). Use 0 for whole numbers, 0.0 for one decimal, 0.00 for two, and so on. Per-attribute overrides live in the row above.

cell_options.name: show_unit
cell_options.label: Units
cell_options.help: Hubitat doesn't send units with device values, so these come from the attribute name (humidity → %, power → W) and the temperature scale set in Hubitat Core.

cell_options.name: show_names
cell_options.label: Names
cell_options.help: Off hides the name on each row when several attributes are listed, leaving icon and value.
